label.zh: 夺船行动的结果（按权重）
label.en: Outcome of the ship-capture attempt (by weight)

note.zh: 敌对飞船阶段：250 带船员俘获（权重2）、260 俘获但无幸存者（1）、270 飞船被毁（1）、280 对方逃脱（1）；无法俘获时前三者为 0；对方主动政策 250 ×1.5、260 ×1.25；对方谨慎 280 ×1.33。
note.en: Hostile-ship stage: 250 captured with crew (weight 2), 260 captured, none alive (1), 270 ship destroyed (1), 280 they escape (1); the first three are 0 if capture is impossible; proactive contacts ×1.5 on 250 and ×1.25 on 260; cautious contacts ×1.33 on 280.

label.zh: 绑架行动的结果（按权重）
label.en: Outcome of the abduction attempt (by weight)

note.zh: 敌对系统阶段：320 成功（权重20）、330 失败（10，之前失败过 ×2）、321 小事故（1，仅在满足严格条件时）。
note.en: Hostile-systems stage: 320 success (weight 20), 330 failure (10, ×2 after an earlier failed attempt), 321 mishap (1, only under strict conditions).

label.zh: 处置俘虏
label.en: What is done with the captives

note.zh: 250/320 的选项决定收尾阶段：审问 → 285（虚弱容易/强壮困难）；活体解剖 → 290；不留活口/吞食 → 295。
note.en: The 250/320 option picks the end stage: interrogate → 285 (weak easy / strong hard), vivisect → 290, no survivors / devour → 295.

label.zh: 结局：审讯完成

note.zh: 按俘虏强弱获得 5–15 点情报和科技进度；格式塔固定 5 情报，结束首次接触。
note.en: Intel 15/10/5 and tech progress 0.3/0.2/0.1 by the captives’ strength (gestalt: fixed 5); first contact ends.

label.zh: 结局：外星研究完成

note.zh: 活体解剖研究；进化掠食者起源另得 DNA 与情境进度（按物种类别）。
note.en: Dissection study; the Evolutionary Predators origin additionally gains DNA and situation progress by species class.

label.zh: 结局：外星材料研究

note.zh: 获得 5 点情报与少量科技进度，结束首次接触。
note.en: 5 intel and a little tech progress; first contact ends.

notes.zh: 审阅注：250 是我方视角（俘获成功）。选项：A审问→对方收到 252；B活体解剖→253；C灭口（灭绝倾向）/ C吞食（吞噬蜂群）→254。各选项还会毁掉被扣飞船并让对方舰队“失踪”。
notes.en: Review note: 250 is the captor’s view. A interrogate → the other side gets 252; B vivisect → 253; C no survivors (homicidal) / devour (devouring swarm) → 254. Each option also destroys the captured ship and sends their fleets missing.

notes.zh: 审阅注：252/253/254/262/272/282/322/332 是被攻击方视角的通知事件（From.Owner 是攻击方）。
notes.en: Review note: 252, 253, 254, 262, 272, 282, 322 and 332 are notifications for the victim (From.Owner is the aggressor).

notes.zh: 审阅注：270/280（失败）可选“再试一次”（若能看到其星系）→ 转入绑架阶段；或回到通用收尾阶段。
notes.en: Review note: after the failures 270/280, “try again” (needs sight of their system) goes to the abduction stage; the other option falls back to the generic end stage.

scope.zh: 敌对首次接触：夺船与绑架两条线共18个事件及阶段衔接。
scope.en: Hostile first contact: the ship-capture and abduction routes — 18 events and stage hand-offs.
